optimizedDescription.value: Extensible pure registry resolves immutable built-ins and namespaced plugin checks with locked binding governance.

optimizedContext.value:
# Check Registry

## Rules
- `CheckRegistry` catalogs canonical `Check` definitions and default `CheckBinding`; expose `get`, `has`, `list`, `bindings`.
- Constructor installs immutable built-ins: protocol, workflow, dependency, workspace, implementation, approval, schema, archive, overlap, verification, hooks. No public built-in mutation/unregister.
- `register(pluginName, check, defaultBindings?, options?)` requires `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$`; canonical ID `@${pluginName}.${check.id}`; duplicate throws `DuplicateCheckError`.
- `CustomCheckDefinition` becomes predicate `Check`; explicit non-predicate `kind` throws `InvalidCheckKindError`. Checks never run commands, subprocesses, or filesystem mutation.
- Binding identity: transition `{checkId,scope:'transition',to,along}`; archive `{checkId,scope:'archive'}`; skip `{checkId,scope:'step-skip',step}`. Exact duplicate throws `DuplicateCheckBindingError`.
- Governance separates placement, binding policy, config, disablement. Code-set false locks monotonic across schema layers; schema-owned bindings remain schema-editable under check-level locks.
- Categories A/B forbid embedding, override, disable; Category C policy checks permit all. Composition forwards every plugin governance field/default binding. Executable application checks, never fixture matchers, serve runtime bindings.
- Resolver deep-merges config: check default → binding → schema; objects merge, arrays concatenate, later scalars replace; runner receives immutable resolved config.

## Constraints
- Pure domain: no filesystem, subprocess, console.
- Existing built-in resolution remains compatible.
- Constructed checks/bindings immutable during workflow.
